entities.summary:
Renzo Vespignani 
was an Italian painter, printmaker and illustrator. Vespignani illustrated the works of Boccaccio, Kafka and T. S. Eliot, among others. In 1956, he co-founded the magazine Citta Aperta  and in 1963, co-founded the group II Pro e II Contro for neorealism in figure art.
